<h2 dir="auto">Summary</h2>
<p dir="auto">The feature requested in this issue has <strong>not been implemented</strong> despite comprehensive camera options being added in PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="2211024701" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/tldraw/tldraw/issues/3282" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tldraw/tldraw/pull/3282/hovercard" href="https://github.com/tldraw/tldraw/pull/3282" aria-keyshortcuts="Alt+ArrowUp">#3282</a>.</p>
<h2 dir="auto">Analysis</h2>
<p dir="auto">The current <code class="notranslate">TLCameraOptions</code> interface includes controls for:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code class="notranslate">panSpeed</code>: Adjust pan sensitivity</li>
<li><code class="notranslate">zoomSpeed</code>: Adjust zoom sensitivity</li>
<li><code class="notranslate">wheelBehavior</code>: Choose between zoom, pan, or none</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">However, <strong>there is no <code class="notranslate">invertZoomDirection</code> or equivalent option</strong> to reverse the scroll zoom direction.</p>
<h2 dir="auto">Current behavior</h2>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Scrolling UP on scroll wheel: Zooms OUT</li>
<li>Scrolling DOWN on scroll wheel: Zooms IN</li>
</ul>
<h2 dir="auto">Requested behavior</h2>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Option to INVERT this direction (like macOS Maps, Apple Photos)</li>
</ul>
<h2 dir="auto">Why this matters</h2>
<p dir="auto">The current behavior doesn't match the muscle memory of users familiar with:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>macOS Maps and Photos apps</li>
<li>Pinch gestures on touch devices (pinching out = index finger moving up)</li>
<li>Many mapping applications</li>
</ul>
<h2 dir="auto">Implementation Path</h2>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Add <code class="notranslate">invertZoomDirection?: boolean</code> to <code class="notranslate">TLCameraOptions</code></li>
<li>Update zoom calculation logic in <code class="notranslate">Editor.ts</code> to respect this option</li>
<li>Add tests and documentation</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">This is a reasonable UX preference that aligns with established patterns in other applications.</p></div></div><div role="toolbar" aria-label="Reactions" class="d-flex gap-1 preference for mouse input (#7732)

This PR adds a new user preference to invert mouse wheel zoom direction.
Some users prefer "natural" scrolling behavior where scrolling down
zooms out (like on macOS trackpads), but this conflicts with traditional
mouse wheel zoom behavior.

This is a clean reimplementation of the original branch
`kostya/scroll-direction-preference` with a narrative-quality commit
history.

closes https://github.com/tldraw/tldraw/issues/6164

### Change type

- [x] `feature`

### Test plan

1. Open the editor
2. Go to Menu → Preferences → Input device
3. Select "Mouse" as your input device
4. Enable "Invert mouse zoom"
5. Use the scroll wheel to zoom - direction should now be inverted
6. Disable the option - zoom should return to normal
7. Change input device to "Auto" - the invert option should appear
disabled

- [x] Unit tests

### Release notes

- Add option to invert mouse wheel zoom direction under Preferences →
Input device
- Rename "Input mode" menu to "Input device" for clarity

### API changes

- Added `isZoomDirectionInverted` to `TLUserPreferences` interface
- Added `UserPreferencesManager.getIsZoomDirectionInverted()` method
- Added `ToggleInvertZoomItem` component export from `@tldraw/tldraw`
- Added `toggle-invert-zoom` action and event
